text:
rachel ng: saw another customer hit mixed-tenant rows in Console after rapid org switches. reproducible on canary-5.

omar el-sayed: details? which codepath - prefetch sidecar or UI merge?

rachel ng: looks like prefetch jobs are enqueuing with snapshot headers. when session rotates, worker runs with stale x-org header and merges results into the current org view. trace attached.

fiona cho: that also breaks quota attribution. we must avoid persisting tenant headers into job blobs.

omar el-sayed: short-term patch: on worker start, resolve session id and compare to job.envelope.x-org. if mismatch, re-resolve and fetch with the resolved org, emit metric `job_org_mismatch`. Feature-flag it for canary.

rachel ng: Agreed. add a tiny UI signal: when we detect a mismatch while merging, show a dismissible banner "Refreshing to ensure correct tenant data" so users don't see mixed rows.

fiona cho: test plan: unit test for mismatch branch + integration quick-switch 200x loop. Gate merge on smoke. Also add billing tag `attribution_corrected=true` when we correct attribution.

omar el-sayed: I'll open PR with flag `worker_resolve_org_on_start`, migration note to sweep queued blobs older than 24h, and rollback instructions.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch fix/worker-resolve-org (unit: 12, integration: 3).

rachel ng: thanks. please ping #release-war-room when canary deploys so support can watch.

fiona cho: after initial canary run (500 quick-switches) mismatch metric dropped to 0. Requeued 4 stale jobs. Closing unless new reports.
